subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: When configured image understanding fails during browser screenshot, should OpenClaw intentionally return only a text failure/share hint, or retain a safe way for the primary model to receive the screenshot?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported persistent-image contamination but removes an existing recovery fallback; source and proof establish the tradeoff, but they cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt text-only recovery
options.body: Approve the PR’s text-only failure result so configured image-understanding failures cannot inject image blocks into session state.

options.title: Preserve screenshot recovery safely
options.body: Keep a model-visible recovery route, but redesign it so an image result cannot persist through the session-history path.

options.title: Pause for browser-owner direction
options.body: Hold the PR until the intended configured-vision failure behavior is documented by the responsible owner.

recommendation.title: Adopt text-only recovery
recommendation.body: Approve the PR’s text-only failure result so configured image-understanding failures cannot inject image blocks into session state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent browser-area work makes this the best available routing candidate for the recovery-contract choice.
